artifact_storage.environment_destination: NEW isolated venv paths only, never old qualified envs

audit_limitation: Initial read-only audit status/rev-parse used GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 without a retained prior direct index snapshot. Subsequent closing read retained snapshots with no index changes; no index reset/restoration performed.

install_rule.verify: pip check; exact distribution inventory/files; pytest version; licensed plugin identities; runtime identity before any actual native use

plugin_rule.native_worker: UNCHANGED native_execution_v3 and its original plugin identity/manifest checks; disable plugin autoload.
plugin_rule.new_pytest_license: Only pytest-cov pytest11 module derived from the exact verified original wheel entry_points.txt; exact distribution/version and entrypoint SHA retained. Other entrypoint groups are evidence only.

scientific_scope: Generic infrastructure preparation only. Neither old diagnostic nor new catalog/green preparation establishes G2-G6 or comparative win. Root reviews complete closure and qualification/freeze proposal before actual native use.

selection_rule.backtracking: Metadata-only newest-first candidate rejection is permitted before target queries. No installed/native/test/task outcome may select versions. Unresolved conflicts/cycles/budget exhaustion remain precise UNKNOWN.
selection_rule.closure: Only three seeds plus recursively justified active Requires-Dist under exact frozen marker environment, extra empty and only explicitly requested external extras. Missing old pin/new closure conflicts remain UNKNOWN; no source-derived self extras.
selection_rule.compatibility: Preserve every old modern pin, artifact and metadata entry. Reject and retain candidate release metadata that conflicts with immutable pins or accumulated dependency constraints; choose highest remaining metadata-compatible stable wheel release. Never upgrade/remove old pins.
selection_rule.metadata: Fetch exact version JSON and selected original wheel; require Name/Version identity and semantic Requires-Dist/Requires-Python agreement.
selection_rule.release_order: Descending PEP440 stable releases from public PyPI project JSON; exclude prerelease/dev/local versions.
selection_rule.wheel_order: Supported CPython3.12/Linux x86_64 wheel tag rank, then filename; require nonyanked, compatible file Requires-Python, exact SHA256 and size.
